entry.title: Helldivers movie to feature Game of Thrones, Dune star known for both action and comedy
entry.summary:
Khal Drogo, Aquaman, Duncan Idaho, and soon, a Helldiver.
Jason Momoa has been tapped to star in the upcoming Helldivers film adaptation from Sony Pictures, according to a new report from Variety. The movie based on the popular co-op alien-shooting PlayStation franchise will release in November 2027.
Image via Warner Bros. Pictures
No other roles or actors were announced at this time, but the movie will be helmed by Justin Lin of Fast & Furious fame. And so PlayStation is continuing its assault on live-action media, following shows like The Last of Us and Twisted Metal, and movies like Uncharted.
Sony's shows and films have been hit or miss when it comes to critics and fans, but Helldivers seems like it could be a natural translation to the silver screen. A bunch of soldiers diving into dangerous planets to fight robots and aliens? CGI galore, lots of action, and some comedy along the way? Yeah, I can see it.
The tongue-in-cheek propaganda and satire within the Helldivers games seem like a good fit for Momoa, who's proven himself able to play action roles with a silly sense of humor attached. His career kicked off with the big Khal Drogo role in Game of Thrones 15 years ago, but he's since tackled iconic characters across a variety of big franchises, so I think he's suited just fine for the IP.
The cool thing about a Helldivers movie is that it doesn't necessarily need a stunning plot, and can be carried by the action and comedic tone alone. But anything is possible, especially considering the movie's scriptwriter. It's Gary Dauberman, who's known for horror films such as It, It Chapter Two, and The Nun.
Color me curious. But for now, maybe set aside some time next November to check the flick out, especially if you're a fan of the game series.

entry.title: How to get and use the Gravitino Coil in No Man’s Sky
entry.summary:
The Gravitino Coil is a new item available in No Man's Sky as part of the Remnants update. It's a new module for your multi-tool device, and it enables you to manage industrial waste in an efficient fashion.
Table of contents How to get the Gravitino Coil in No Man's Sky How to use Gravitino Coil in No Man's Sky
How to get the Gravitino Coil in No Man's Sky
The Gravitino Coil upgrade can be obtained from Eos at the Anomaly. Take the path to the left of the Nexus and go up one floor. You'll find a bunch of NPCs at this spot, helping you get different upgrades. Go to the vendor who offers multi-tool upgrades.
Screenshot by Destructoid
First, you have to purchase the Gravitino Coil blueprint. The blueprint will cost 420 Nanite Clusters. Once done, you'll need the following resources.
Three Magnetic Resonators
One Gravitino Ball
50 Chromatic Metal
You can find the Gravitino Ball on planets with an extreme Sentinel condition. The remaining resources are not that hard to find. If you're a beginner, you will have to complete a few upgrades along the path.
Terrain Manipulator
Advanced Mining Laser
Once the blueprint is ready, you can install the module on your multi-tool.
Screenshot by Destructoid
How to use Gravitino Coil in No Man's Sky
Once you have found a bunch of waste, activate the Gravitino Coil by pressing G. Then, press the RMB to pull the industrial waste. If you press the LMB, the materials will be launched by the coil (similar to a projectile). If you press the RMB, the coil will gently release all the magnetised materials.
The Gravitino Coil is immensely useful for removing industrial waste. It allows you to look for useful resources in areas that otherwise wouldn't have been possible before the Remnants update.

entry.title: USN-7942-2: GLib vulnerabilities
entry.summary:
USN-7942-1 fixed vulnerabilities in GLib. This update provides the corresponding updates for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. CVE-2025-3360 only affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.
Original advisory details:
It was discovered that GLib incorrectly handled escaping URI strings. An attacker could use this issue to cause GLib to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-13601)
It was discovered that GLib incorrectly parsed certain GVariants. An attacker could use this issue to cause GLib to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-14087)
It was discovered that GLib incorrectly parsed certain long invalid ISO 8601 timestamps. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause GLib to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2025-3360)
It was discovered that GLib incorrectly handled GString memory operations. An attacker could use this issue to cause GLib to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2025-6052)
It was discovered that GLib incorrectly handled creating temporary files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to access unauthorized data. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2025-7039)

I resent that the PRs use it for every virtual press event. I’m furious that I have to download 12 updates whenever I remember to turn it on. I despise the feisty and cloying loading screen trivia and service messages. Show me the “empathy banana” again, you weird little gopher beetle. I’ll put you in the microwave. However kind, it has the potential to be demeaning, intrusive, even abusive. In my experience of doctors and hospitals, healing is a competition between interpretations of sickness and injury, where the doctor has at their disposal all the crushing cultural authority and ornate vocabularies of modern medicine. The patient’s own self-knowledge - amassed over years of living in and with their own flesh - risks being recast as 'amateurish'. While these IPTV users aren't currently facing charges, a looming law change in July 2026 could soon turn these types of 'customer lists' into evidence for copyright infringement fines. From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

entry.title: Audio recenze: Silent Hill: Noční můry [Return to Silent Hill] - 60 %
entry.summary: Třetí (a první) Silent Hill je příkladem toho, jak věrně a s úctou je možné filmově adaptovat videohru. To ale bohužel neznamená, že výsledek je film, na který stojí za to chodit do kina. Místo toho se můžu 10 hodin dívat na YouTube jak někdo hraje Silent Hill, a horší zážitek to nebude. (Ilča 40 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: Poslední Viking [Den sidste viking] - 70 %
entry.summary: Chtěl jsem původně napsat, že jde o příjemně brutální "nenáročnou" lacinou komedii, ale ono to JE náročné, natočit komedii, která má tempo, její pointy fungují a herci chápou, jak je potřeba hrát. Protože si nevzpomínám, kdy jsem naposledy viděl ČESKOU komedii, které by se to povedlo aspoň takhle dobře, a Dánům to zřejmě nedělá nejmenší problém. (Ilča 40 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: Hamnet - 40 %
entry.summary: Netradiční mix atmosférického historického dramatu a hardcore artfilmu. Na plátně je vidět talent, ale je to natočeno pro někoho, kdo zná Hamleta a Shakespeara buď mnohem lépe (první tři čtvrtiny) nebo mnohem hůře (poslední čtvrtina) než já. Velice se mi líbil shakespearovský film "Anonym", ale tady jsem se nudil velmi podobně jako při "Pohled do slunce". (Ilča 50 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: Šviháci - 40 %
entry.summary: Slušně řemeslně zvládnutý film se slušnými hereckými výkony (včetně Helenky), který doplácí na extrémně odbytý scénář. Ten se snaží na úkor nejzákladnější dějové logiky dostrkat děj do kýžených situací ("Klučina začne dělat různé průšvihy v lázních"), které pak trestuhodně nevyužije. To, co se zdá být hlavní zápletkou (t.j. "Manželka odhalí, že jí manžel byl nevěrný a má syna s milenkou") začne až nějakých 20 minut před koncem a neobsahuje to žádný pokus o humor. Prostě se komedie najednou změní v drama a očekávaný happyend je 20 minut odkládán, aby nakonec proběhl přesně tak, jak jsem se obával, t.j. "Nevadí, že jsi všem sedm let lhal, stejně tě máme rádi". (Ilča 20 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: 28 let poté: Chrám z kostí [28 Years Later: The Bone Temple] - 90 %
entry.summary: Trochu jsem se bál, že to po změně režiséra nebude tak dobré jako předchozí film, ale je to ještě o kousek lepší! Nevěřil bych, že to nerežíroval Boyle. Výborná atmosféra, výborní herci a situace/hlášky, které se budou hojně citovat. Vynikající worldbuilding a těším se na další pokračování. (Ilča 80 %)
